_comment: Scholarly identifiers. EVERY VALUE IS null UNTIL NICK SUPPLIES IT. Nothing here is guessed, derived or placeholder-shaped: an identifier that is not owned is not an identifier. Read at build time by R/identifiers.R.
_howto: 1. Put the bare identifier (not a URL) in `value` for each profile you actually have.
3. Any entry still null stays OUT of the built HTML entirely — no empty row, no dead link,
no 'coming soon'. The block itself disappears if every value is null, which is today's state.
4. Optional: mirror the resulting profile URLs into the schema.org `sameAs` array in
_meta_index.html, where a marked placeholder comment is waiting.

profiles.label: ORCID
profiles.where: https://orcid.org — free, self-registered; the one worth having first.

profiles.label: Google Scholar
profiles.value_looks_like: the 12-character `user=` token from your Scholar profile URL
profiles.where: https://scholar.google.com/citations — claim the profile, then copy the token.

profiles.label: RePEc
profiles.value_looks_like: pan123 — the RePEc Short-ID from your Author Service registration

profiles.label: SSRN
profiles.where: https://ssrn.com — author id appears once a paper is posted.
